text:
alex_h: Heads up — after today's merge to main (PR #4231) canary shows +35% p95 decode on gpt-m and long-doc load tests. Repro locally with same commit.

maria_g: Which tests? any kernel-selector or fused-op changes in the PR?

alex_h: Both. PR touched kernel selection heuristics, fused op fusion priority, and batching micro-thresholds.

tony_r: CI perf job runtime/decode_p95 failed: https://ci.redwood/9876 — baseline 72ms -> 98ms (+36%).

ci-bot: perf job alert: runtime/perf/decode_p95 exceeded threshold by 36% (run 9876). See artifacts.

dmitri_v: I ran perf + flamegraphs on canary VM. Decode hot path shows more time in select_attention_kernel and an extra memcpy in fused_embed_union. KV cache miss rate up ~12%.

kathy: stack excerpt: ```#0 select_attention_kernel
#1 fused_forward
#2 decode_loop
memcpy at 0x7f... (heavy)``` Also attached perf record from local repro.

maria_g: Question: batching heuristic tweak in PR changed micro-batch threshold 4 -> 2, right? That will create more small batches.

tony_r: Repro: setting OVERRIDE_BATCH_SIZE=2 locally restores the slowdown. With >=4 p95 returns to baseline.

alex_h: So candidate root cause: lower batching threshold causing more small-batch traces which trigger attention kernel fallback + extra memcpy in fused path.

sre-oncall: Pausing canary rollout at 50% and escalating. :warning: Need 10-min hold for hotpatch.

maria_g: I'll prepare a minimal revert that restores micro-batch threshold and re-run perf. If that fixes, we'll cherry-pick as hotpatch.

dmitri_v: Note: kernel selector also has a guard that prefers fused kernels only when batch >=4; with batch=2 selection falls back to generic kernel (slower) — interplay likely.

tony_r: Plan: 1) revert batching threshold in canary 2) run full perf matrix 3) if green, merge hotpatch and continue rollout. If not, revert fused-op pass next.

alex_h: Agreed. I'll file a short release-blocker note and assign for rollback. Thanks everyone.

ci-bot: hotpatch PR #4245 created, perf checks queued.
